newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche appoints new chief spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche appoints new chief spokesman.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Friday Dierk Hartwig, deputy editor of "Boersen-Zeitung" newspaper, would become head of its press department in 1997.
Hartwig, 52, would replace Deutsche's current chief press spokesman, Hellmut Hartmann, 60, who will step down in May 1997, Deutsche said in a statement.
The switch will coincide with the move of chief executive Hilmar Kopper into the supervisory board, the bank said. Kopper will be replaced as chief executive by management board member Rolf Breuer.
